title: Algebraic center of an Etingof-Kazhdan quantization of a finite-dimensional Poisson group over a characteristic-zero field
author: Adrien Brochier
source_title: A Duflo Star Product for Poisson Groups
difficulty_reason: The proof must correct duality in the Drinfeld category for an arbitrary associator so that dualizing the coalgebra actually gives the required algebra and monoidal fiber-functor equivalence. It then proves centrality by a braided coalgebra counit argument and transports the undeformed invariant algebra into the quantization. These associator-dependent coherence and deformation-quantization constructions exceed the classical enveloping-algebra center statement.

proof_review.note: Complete4.2/4.1 and new3.4 duality correction read, with monoidal functor and coalgebra/algebra support3.5-3.12. Graphical author proofs and maps on physical7-10 were visually inspected, including modified-coevaluation natural equivalence and all4.3/4.4 centrality diagrams. Transport from an even associator, universal twist J, central adjustment u and alpha,beta correct the dual tensor identification. Prior Drinfeld/Le-Murakami and EK quantization results are established background; the new correction and center argument are supplied. The last center-surjectivity sentence is the standard formal-adic leading-coefficient induction: the displayed inclusion already lifts each Poisson-central coefficient, and formal completeness is part of the stated quantization setting. No independent reconstruction of cited associator existence, no Kontsevich star-product equivalence or separate classical Duflo consequence counted.

statement_scope: Finite-dimensional Poisson formal, Lie or algebraic group G over a characteristic-zero field K in the source setting, and O_hbar(G) from a fixed Etingof-Kazhdan associator quantization functor. Its algebraic center is isomorphic as a K[[hbar]] algebra to Z_Poisson(O(G))[[hbar]], via the author corrected-duality comparison with the companion monoidal quantization. All deformation products and formal completions are retained. No specialization hbar=1, canonical ordinary inclusion into the original functorial quantization, or arbitrary Poisson-manifold claim.

Standard Drinfeld/Le–Murakami and Etingof–Kazhdan quantization facts remain cited prerequisites; formal completeness and completed products retain the author setting. No hbar=1 specialization, ordinary-inclusion claim for the functorial product, classical Duflo corollary or conjectural Kontsevich-product equivalence is counted.
